text:
Porter Martone, the sixth overall pick in 2025, has 8 points in 18 games as a 20-year-old rookie. That's exactly the median for forwards taken where he went, 0.44 points a game. His shooting sits on the league average; nothing is inflated. Kevin Kurz of The Athletic pointed out that he has been quietly heating up, with points in four of five before Nov. 5.

He is playing 13:54 a night with four power-play points, and Philadelphia is 7 points better in expected goal share with him on the ice than without. That's a good sign for a rookie on a team that is losing more than it wins. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, from a small 9-game sample last season, had 70 percent of his shots coming off the rush, though he rarely carried the puck in himself.

The Flyers' conversation is about Matvei Michkov's minutes right now. Martone's will grow too if he keeps this up. Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports called him "the highest upside young piece" on the team.
headline: Martone is learning on the job, and heating up
